about: The introitus of the formulary “Saint James the Apostle” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: But to me, O God, Your friends are honored exceedingly; their sovereignty is made exceedingly strong. O Lord, You have tested me and known me; You have known my sitting down and my rising up. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. But to me, O God, Your friends are honored exceedingly; their sovereignty is made exceedingly strong.
